usedFor: Teams use Botbiz to add contacts with “Create Subscriber” and label them with “Assign Labels To Subscriber”.

bestTemplate.name: “Create Subscriber” in Botbiz
bestTemplate.why: Every new contact lands as a subscriber, ready to be labelled for later messages.

watchOut: Messages like “Send WhatsApp Message” go out through your Botbiz account, and one to a customer waits for your approval.
